name: Reverse (Short) Double Diagonal
summary: Double diagonal with the expiries inverted - long the near-term strangle, short the farther-dated strangle. Leaves naked short options after the near-term longs expire. BAD IDEA for this system.

legs.dte_rule: BACK expiry, later than the front

max_profit: limited and model-dependent; realized on a fast near-term move
max_loss: UNDEFINED after the front expiry - the remaining back-month shorts are naked
when_to_use: Steep contango in the term structure (back-month IV far above front) combined with a near-term breakout expectation. Rare, and better expressed as a calendar sold outright by a desk with naked approval.
entry_rules: DO NOT TRADE on this account. Requires Alpaca options level 4 (uncovered short calls and puts) because the shorts outlive the longs; level 3 will reject it.
If a level 4 account ever ran it: hard requirement to close the back-month shorts on or before the front expiration date, and modeled naked risk capped by an external stop
management_rules: Not applicable - the structure is not permitted at level 3
exit_rules: If ever held, the back-month shorts must be closed no later than the front expiration day close; carrying naked shorts is outside this system's risk policy
Standard ITM guards apply to the back-month shorts at all times: close if extrinsic < $0.10 or |delta| >= 0.85
assignment_risk: Severe and unhedged after the front expiry: naked short call means unlimited loss plus a short share position on assignment; naked short put means an obligation to buy 100 shares per contract with no offsetting long.
buying_power: Naked margin requirement (roughly 20% of underlying notional less OTM amount per short) - far larger than any defined-risk structure.
liquidity_needs: Irrelevant - not to be traded here.
common_mistakes: Building a double diagonal with the expiries reversed by accident. Add a pre-submit validator: every short leg's expiry must be <= the covering long leg's expiry.
family: four-leg structures (iron condors, iron butterflies, condors, double calendars/diagonals, boxes, jelly rolls, conversions/reversals, double verticals, double ratio spreads)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
